relationships.statement: "A person can edit an entry's work and duration, and when an entry exists and the person edits its work and its duration, the entry shows the escaped edited work and duration." depends on "Starting and stopping a timer records the entry's duration; when an entry shows a running timer and the person stops the timer, the entry shows a duration equal to the elapsed time between starting and stopping, and the timer no longer runs.".
conditions: R5 requires editing an entry's work and duration, and R4 requires the timer to record the entry's duration when stopped
